This is a note before the actual conversation.

BEGIN CONVERSATION
Student: I am confused about classification. Is it just grouping things?
Tutor: Not exactly. Classification predicts a predefined class label from labeled data.
Student: So clustering is different because labels are not predefined?
Tutor: Correct. Clustering groups points without target labels.
END CONVERSATION
